remeasured_no_answer_separation.reason: The corpus drifted after the first calibration. Re-measured on a read-only copy of the live database, on BOTH splits. The shipped 12.75 was below the highest abstain score, so final-18 leaked a result (a false result on a question the corpus cannot answer).
remeasured_no_answer_separation.shipped_position: inside the gap, low of centre: losing a real answer is a silent failure, a leaking abstention is visible in the metrics

decision: A candidate must pass at least one interpretable threshold. Exact IDs and exact literal paths or key=value tokens bypass semantic scoring. Thresholds were selected on calibration only; the final split was frozen first and was not inspected for tuning.
engine_note: Thresholds are only valid for this engine. Measured 2026-09-12: identical code, rows and query scored final-18 at 12.774338 under 0.34.0 (abstains at 12.8) but 14.397717 under 0.38.0 (leaks). The container had drifted to 0.38.0 via a floating 'lancedb>=0.33.0' pin, which made the threshold a no-op in production without any source change.
